sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Purple Enamel Floral Gold Pendant Necklace
sourceNotes.rawContent: Make a statement with this vibrant purple enamel flower necklace. Featuring a lustrous metallic finish and a dainty gold-toned chain, this anti-tarnish pendant adds a bold yet feminine touch to your style. It is the perfect durable accessory for elevating your everyday look
